title: ～ずつ — “～ each / ～ at a time”
summary: Attaches to an amount or number and shows that the same quantity applies to each person, item or time. Also used for gradual progress (少しずつ). It follows a quantity word and is placed before a verb.

patterns.gloss: 二枚ずつ, 一錠ずつ (same amount each)

patterns.form: 副詞（少し・ゆっくり など）＋ずつ

body.p: 一人に二枚ずつ配る: two to each person. The unit (each person) is marked with に, the amount with ずつ. In 朝と夜に一錠ずつ, the same amount is taken at each time.
With 少し, ずつ expresses a gradual process: 少しずつ上手になる. This is typical for learning and habits: 少しずつでいいから、毎日続けることが大切だ.
ごとに means “every (time unit / each item)” and focuses on the repetition. ずつ focuses on the amount allotted. 1時間ごとに休む vs 1時間に10分ずつ休む.

examples.ja: 一人（ひとり）に二枚（にまい）ずつ配（くば）ってください。
examples.romaji: Hitori ni nimai zutsu kubatte kudasai.
examples.tr: Please hand out two sheets to each person.

examples.ja: 薬（くすり）は朝（あさ）と夜（よる）に一錠（いちじょう）ずつ飲（の）んでください。
examples.romaji: Kusuri wa asa to yoru ni ichijou zutsu nonde kudasai.
examples.tr: Please take one tablet each, morning and night.

examples.ja: 少（すこ）しずつでいいから、毎日（まいにち）続（つづ）けることが大切（たいせつ）だ。
examples.romaji: Sukoshi zutsu de ii kara, mainichi tsudzukeru koto ga taisetsu da.
examples.tr: A little at a time is fine; what matters is keeping it up every day.

pitfalls: Do not use ずつ for different amounts each time. It means the same amount.
It follows the quantity, not the noun: 二枚ずつ, not 紙ずつ.
